version.changelog:
**send-experiment-designer 13.0.0 — Major update providing structured test design and significance readout for email experiments**

- Supports designing four types of email experiments: A/B, multivariate, send-time, and hold-out tests, with one-variable-per-cell variant matrices.
- Now reads finished experiment results, assessing significance with a clear promote/kill/keep-testing call.
- Produces hypotheses, sample size and MDE calculations, run duration, and power plans for any supported test mode.
- Clearly defines boundaries: handles only experiment design and significance read—not EQS scoring, vetoes, or email copywriting (use linked skills for those).
- Guides users on required and optional inputs, returning NEEDS_INPUT if essential data is missing.
- Outputs a standardized handoff summary for seamless integration with related analytics and quality auditing tools.

llm.summary: The skill bundle has powerful admin and observability workflows, but the artifacts disclose those capabilities and scope them to expected ClawHub, OpenClaw, Convex, Axiom, and Sentry tasks.

dimensions.detail: The reviewed skills cover broad but coherent purposes: code review, production release, moderation, content-rights correspondence, Convex work, design/docs, and Axiom/Sentry observability. High-impact actions such as email, moderation, deploys, dashboard/monitor changes, and incident tooling fit those stated purposes.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are generally task-bounded and include safeguards such as explicit targets, dry runs, confirmation gates for destructive/admin actions, no autonomous posting, and secret-handling rules. Some Axiom scripts can create or update resources when directly invoked, which is expected for those skills.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Artifacts are plain skill markdown, references, scripts, assets, provenance files, and repo-local metadata. I found no install-time auto-execution, persistence hook, or hidden startup mechanism.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Network/API use, local config reads, credentials, GitHub/Slack/Sentry/Axiom/Convex access, and external reviewer model calls are disclosed and proportionate to the workflows. Users should expect these skills to use existing local auth/config where configured.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The Axiom SRE workflow creates local config and memory under the user's config directory and can sync org memory via Git when configured; ClawHub release/moderation skills can trigger privileged remote changes only through explicit commands and user-controlled gates. No covert persistence was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you intend to grant these skills access to the relevant operational tools. Review configured Axiom/Sentry/Slack/GitHub/Convex credentials and be especially deliberate before running moderation, email, production release, monitor, dashboard, or shared-memory commands.
llm.findings:
[SkillSpector:clean] expected: SkillSpector reported no issues; artifact review found no hidden or purpose-mismatched behavior that would override that signal.
[VirusTotal:clean] expected: VirusTotal telemetry showed 64 undetected engines and no malicious or suspicious detections; this was treated as supporting telemetry, not as the sole basis for the verdict.
